raw:
When my sister was moving to another country, we had one last breakfast together at the station. That’s a time I remember feeling sad. Her suitcases had been packed before the weekend, so I knew she was going, but sitting there with her made it feel much more real.

We were having breakfast together, something so ordinary, and I kept thinking that we wouldn’t be able to do that so easily anymore. I wanted to enjoy being with her rather than spend the whole time thinking about her leaving, but it was hard to separate the two. She was still right there with me, and I was already missing her. That’s what stays with me most about that breakfast.
